dossier_meta.paper: Open problems of the 33rd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings
dossier_meta.statement_text:
If a cubic graph admits a $2$-homogeneous coloring,
then $4$ colors are always sufficient.
dossier_meta.context_text: A $k$-homogeneous coloring is a proper vertex coloring in which exactly $k$ colors appear in the open neighborhood of every vertex. For bipartite cubic graphs it is known that at most 6 colors suffice for a 2-homogeneous coloring; the conjecture asks whether 4 always suffice whenever a 2-homogeneous coloring exists.
